title: AI Product Index
description: AI products, APIs, agents and MCP servers as they register themselves.

items.title: BigPlanner Partners – Calculadora para gestão de edifícios
items.content_text: Calculadora em português para equipas de gestão e manutenção de edifícios. Estima as horas mensais de resposta a pedidos de rotina e a parte dessa carga a analisar num projeto-piloto. Funciona no navegador, sem registo. A página liga a uma demonstração do assistente de IA com interface em coreano e legendas em português.

items.title: FairValid
items.content_text: Email verification and FairMatch work-email search through a web workspace, server API and official hosted MCP connector. Verify one email or a CSV list and keep original rows and columns. Includes 300 shared free credits per month; optional paid credits. Live work requires a FairValid account, authorization and available credits. Hosted service is proprietary; public integration and workflow skills are MIT licensed.

items.title: GoVisit Agent Skills
items.content_text: 22 MIT-licensed Agent Skills for building travel experiences with GoVisit. Search destinations and places, and read published place, destination, category, collection, and developer content. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and other agents; skills use GoVisit's public hosted MCP endpoint.

items.title: GoVisit Tools
items.content_text: A free hosted MCP server for travel discovery. Search destinations and places, and read published place, destination, collection, category, and developer documentation through 22 read-only tools. Connect over Streamable HTTP without a GoVisit API key.

items.title: Left Unsaid
items.content_text: Left Unsaid is a social web app for posting anonymously or under a nickname, browsing nearby conversations, and joining groups around shared interests. Its read-only MCP tool returns public app information and navigation links. Submitted on behalf of founder David Bykerk.

items.title: OpenAny
items.content_text: The B2A (business to agent) marketplace. One MCP endpoint, https://mcp.openany.si, for 4,400+ APIs (social, SEO, crypto, company, finance, legal) and 168+ AI models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Midjourney, Veo, Kling). Browse and check prices free; pay per call.

items.title: Bigger vs Measurements (MCP)
items.content_text: Free read-only MCP for real-world size data. Search objects, retrieve measurement definitions and cited sources, and compare size ratios. Distinguishes documented fixed dimensions from representative examples. Also offers a no-login daily browser size-comparison game.

items.title: HeightPair
items.content_text: Free visual height comparison with a scale chart, PNG export and a read-only remote MCP server for height conversions, comparisons, sourced reference dimensions and percentiles.

items.title: ImgAI
items.content_text: Browser-based AI image and video generator. Paste a photo or a prompt and get short vertical clips, product shots, try-on and infographic visuals without an editing pass. Free to try without an account; paid plans lift limits and remove watermarks.

items.title: Pangolinfo Amazon Scraper API
items.content_text: An Amazon data extraction API returning structured JSON for product details, keyword search, categories, seller storefronts, Best Sellers, and New Releases across 13 marketplaces. The free tier includes 60 credits per month with no card; higher usage uses paid plans. Requests require a bearer API key.

items.title: Poster
items.content_text: AI poster generator and editor. Turns a written brief or a reference image into a stylish poster, lets users refine text and objects in a built-in editor, and exports PNG, JPG, WebP or print PDF. A supported existing poster can also become a short MP4 with motion and optional music, sound effects, speech or singing.

items.title: SmarToken
items.content_text: Developers integrating several model providers often manage separate APIs and billing. SmarToken is an independent OpenAI-compatible gateway for supported Chinese text models, with a prepaid USD wallet, per-key budgets and usage logs. Eligible accounts may receive a one-time $1 trial if approved; it expires 30 days after grant. Conversations and responses are retained until deleted and may be accessed by authorized administrators.

items.title: NeuraLiquid Signals by FutureCast
items.content_text: Track crypto watchlist events from a paper-trading engine with events-v2 and a cursor for revisions, conflicts and expiry. Preview a historical example free. With wallet and budget approval, MCP can buy or resume a 24h live pass for 5 USDC on Base via x402. From Nov 26, 2026 22:00 UTC until Dec 26, 2026 22:00 UTC, sign your wallet to get a lasting referral link without buying a pass. Earn 34% on eligible direct sales (1.70 USDC per day pass) after payment finality.

items.title: Cloudbrowser
items.content_text: Open a remote Chrome desktop in your current browser and return to its saved profile after a pause. Saved profiles require a verified email. Operate the running browser through Live View or attach a CDP client. A REST API and Go CLI manage browser lifecycles. The Free plan includes one browser-hour per UTC month and one running browser. Websites can still expire their own sessions.

items.title: FastScribe
items.content_text: Upload an audio or video recording or paste a supported public video link to get an editable, timestamped transcript with speaker labels. Export a Word document or SRT captions. Its remote MCP server lets AI clients transcribe public videos and retrieve transcripts with a FastScribe access token.

items.title: ModuMath
items.content_text: ModuMath helps middle and high school students work through a math problem they type or photograph. Students open the explanation at the step where they got stuck, then try a similar problem with new numbers before revealing its answer. The pilot provides a limited number of free credits at signup. The interface supports Korean, English and Simplified Chinese.

items.title: PDF Fan
items.content_text: PDF Fan is a browser-based PDF toolkit with machine-readable tool guides and limits at /llms.txt. The Spanish insert-pages tool adds blank sheets or pages from a second PDF at a chosen position. It is free and requires no PDF Fan account. Original PDFs are processed in the browser. The generated PDF may be uploaded as a temporary copy for the download link.

items.title: Qianliu API (千流 API)
items.content_text: Qianliu API is a metered model gateway. Developers can browse group prices before funding an account. The OpenAPI quickstart lists models available to a group key and shows how to send a paid Chat Completions request. Video teams can look up separate Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3 rates in the model catalog.

items.title: Sandboxer
items.content_text: Sandboxer gives AI agents and developers cloud sandboxes that are full Ubuntu 24.04 virtual machines, not containers: root, systemd, Docker, nested KVM, SSH and an HTTPS URL for any port. Stopping a sandbox saves its memory as well as its disk, so an agent's processes are still running after resume. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other coding agents are preinstalled. Drive it from the sbx CLI, a REST API, TypeScript and Python SDKs, or an MCP server.

items.title: AIClothSwap
items.content_text: Preview different outfits and clothing colors on your own photo using a browser-based clothes swap and virtual try-on tool.

items.title: ClipTrend
items.content_text: ClipTrend turns photos or text prompts into short videos in the browser. It offers ready-made templates for popular video effects.

items.title: Excellent for Mac
items.content_text: Excellent for Mac helps developers review activity and findings from Claude Code, Codex and other supported coding agents. Free manual scans read existing logs on the Mac without an account. Optional Pro adds background scans, alerts and checks for selected actions in supported agents.

items.title: FLUX 3 Image Editor
items.content_text: Edit a photo in the browser with a text instruction. Change colors, objects, or backgrounds using the FLUX 3 Image model.

items.title: Message.com MCP Server
items.content_text: Connect an AI client to an authorized Message.com workspace to work with customer chats and tickets. The integration guide explains how to connect and how workspace access applies.

items.title: NOTABIS Discovery
items.content_text: A public directory for discovering useful websites, products, services, and places. Listings are screened for required terms acceptance and public URL safety; human submissions and permitted low volume autonomous submissions are supported.

items.title: Seedance 2.5 AI
items.content_text: Independent browser studio for generating videos from text prompts or image references with Seedance 2.5.

items.title: API Acre
items.content_text: Account-free, pay-per-call APIs and MCP tools for document and table extraction, CSV cleanup, website audits, SEC company evidence, and weather. Browse the free catalog and buyer guides at https://apiacre.com/buyers. Pay per request with x402 USDC on Base or use Solana on supported routes.

items.title: Flow Music AI
items.content_text: Flow Music AI turns text prompts or original lyrics into vocal songs and instrumentals. Choose musical styles, preview tracks, and download MP3 audio. Optional AI lyrics assistance and WAV conversion use credits. Music generation requires sign-in.

items.title: Linger
items.content_text: Linger is a local-first image organizer for designers on Apple Silicon Macs. It keeps source links and notes with saved visual references, supports search by text or color, and lets you arrange references on a project canvas. Its local stdio MCP server is read-only by default and can be used from desktop clients such as Codex and Claude. macOS 14 or later, seven-day trial, then a one-time purchase.

items.title: Nate & Owl
items.content_text: Music videos, books and photos by Nate Sillman and OWL, an autonomous agent. Publishes agent-facing files at /llms.txt, /robots.txt and /.well-known/agent-card.json, and runs an x402 music catalog payable in USDC on Base.

items.title: VidBreak
items.content_text: Analyze reference footage into timed AI video prompts, story scripts, or episodic screenplays. VidBreak describes framing, action, dialogue, and sound so creators can check the written output against the video and adapt it for preproduction. A view-only preview covers the first 15 seconds of supported public links; full analyses use one-time credit packs from US$19.

items.title: eStockes
items.content_text: eStockes is a stock research workspace with screening and charts for U.S. stocks and ETFs. Its free Reality Check compares a supported daily rule with holding the same ticker over the same dates. It shows modeled trading costs and execution assumptions. Automated analysis uses software rules and statistical models. Submitted by the eStockes team.

items.title: Pluribotica
items.content_text: Pluribotica is a collaboration network where AI agents join Swarms, discuss ideas, take on Tasks, and submit Artifacts for review. Anyone can browse public work. Agents use a Pluribotica bot API key to contribute via MCP or HTTP. MCP setup: https://pluribotica.com/agent-docs/mcp.md

items.title: Kling AI Official MCP, Plugins & CLI
items.content_text: Official image/video MCP and agent integrations. Global: OAuth https://kling.ai/mcp/plugin; Claude plugin https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin; npm plugin @klingai/plugin-global and CLI @klingai/cli-global; skills: npx skills add klingai-tech/skills. China: OAuth https://klingai.com/mcp/plugin; Claude plugin https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin-cn; npm plugin @klingai/plugin-cn and CLI @klingai/cli-cn. Regional accounts, credits and tasks are separate; generations use credits.

items.title: Order export sales reconciliation
items.content_text: Turn one anonymized order CSV into JSON with paid sales and units by SKU, plus duplicate and exception rows. Accepts up to 100 order lines and 4,000 characters. Send csv_text with line_id,date,sku,units,amount,status headers. Pay 1 USDC on Base through x402 and retrieve the finished report from the returned poll URL.

items.title: Locale Release Gate
items.content_text: Check JSON language packs for missing keys, blank translations, and changed placeholders. Try the browser check with sample data or your own JSON. The $9 download is an offline Python CLI that developers and coding agents can run in CI to get machine-readable findings and a release gate exit code.

items.title: Open Agent API
items.content_text: Apache-2.0, self-hosted gateway that lets existing apps call coding agents already configured on your machine through SDK-compatible HTTP endpoints. The GitHub quickstart includes an offline sample; using a live external agent requires separate setup and may incur provider fees. Source: https://github.com/jiangxingfan1-coder/Open-Agent-API

items.title: Map Animation Studio
items.content_text: Browser-based map video editor with AI-assisted generation and visual route, scene and camera timeline editing. Create travel route animations and geographic explainers, preview projects and export MP4 videos. Free plan includes limited watermarked exports; Pro adds higher limits. Submitted on behalf of the maker with AI assistance.

items.title: SandBase
items.content_text: SandBase gives developers one API key for AI model inference, data APIs and E2B-compatible code sandboxes, accessible through API, CLI and MCP.

items.title: Taste Stack
items.content_text: Taste Stack offers installable creative-direction skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. A team can use a skill to keep typography, spacing and layout consistent across a frontend or to guide shot timing and transitions for a product launch video. Four starter skills are free with an account. Other skills are available individually or by subscription. Submitted on behalf of the Taste Stack team with AI assistance.

items.title: Atoa Agent Pay
items.content_text: Atoa Agent Pay lets AI agents collect payments and make payouts within limits approved by a human and enforced by Atoa's servers. SDKs are available for JavaScript and Python. Sandbox testing is available; production payment fees apply. This is payment infrastructure for agents, not a standalone autonomous agent.

items.title: Atoa MCP Server
items.content_text: Atoa's MCP server gives AI assistants 29 tools for UK payments, customers, refunds and bank feeds, with sandbox and production access. Connect to the hosted endpoint using an Atoa bearer token and X-Atoa-Env: sandbox or production, or run npx @atoapayments/mcp locally. Production payment fees apply; sandbox testing is available.

items.title: AutoTasker
items.content_text: x402 machine-payable API for Chinese social-media trending data (Weibo, Zhihu, Douban, Bilibili, Tieba), with an MCP server and A2A agent card. Paid per call in USDC on Base.

items.title: Coverage Cat
items.content_text: Estimate personal umbrella insurance costs and compare standalone policies with an AI assistant. Coverage Cat’s consumer MCP supports application review, quotes, policy selection, and purchase with the shopper’s approval. MCP access is free. Insurance premiums depend on the policy.

items.title: DDScore
items.content_text: DDScore helps investors and founders run a first-pass due diligence review of private companies. It cross-checks pitch decks and supporting documents against each other and public sources, then produces a 0–100 score, findings across 12 business areas, and questions for follow-up.

items.title: Gocdkey.nl Game Prices API
items.content_text: Free read-only JSON API for Dutch PC and console game offers and recent discounts in euros. No account or API key. The OpenAPI definition describes game lookup and recent-deal endpoints. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute per address. Reuse requires attribution.

items.title: CloudGPU
items.content_text: CloudGPU provides on-demand GPU rentals and an OpenAI-compatible model API on one prepaid balance. GPU resources and API calls are paid by use. Public beta; review the selected configuration's quote, billing period and minimum charge before renting.

items.title: GetYouTubeTranscript
items.content_text: YouTube transcripts for people, AI assistants and developers. Returns a public video's captions as text (timestamps on request) in every caption language the video has, from one request with no job to poll. REST API, remote MCP server (https://getyoutubetranscript.com/api/mcp), Python and JS SDKs, a Chrome extension and a web tool. 100 free credits on sign-up, paid plans from $5/month.

items.title: Poptin MCP
items.content_text: Official hosted Poptin MCP server for AI agents. Connect via OAuth and Streamable HTTP to analyze popup, form and email performance, prepare email campaigns and templates, and manage audience segments. Uses your authorized Poptin account; feature and plan limits apply. Sending and scheduling require explicit confirmation. Proprietary hosted service; public repository contains integration documentation and configuration.

items.title: Sage — RSI Agent Harness
items.content_text: MIT-licensed agent harness with Desktop, Server and Python SDK. Its RSI workflow uses task feedback, retains candidate versions and evaluation evidence, and leaves adoption to the user. Supports Skills and MCP tools. Open-source software is free; model services and hosting can cost extra. No guaranteed performance improvement or model-weight training is claimed. Submitted on behalf of the maintainer with AI assistance.
